title: Polynomial-time chunk extraction
statement: The function obtained by encoding the two projections of an input as nested pairs, iterating the specified chunk update for one more than the input length, and taking the second projection three times is polynomial-time computable. In the update, if the first component of the second projection is empty, the pair is unchanged; otherwise, the first component is retained and the second component is replaced by the encoding that rearranges its prefix of that length, the remaining suffix, and the corresponding prefix of the original second component.
caveat: The statement depends on several auxiliary constructions whose informal descriptions are not supplied, so the update and its rearrangement cannot be made fully explicit here.
